status_vocabulary.CURRENT: Current admitted research/source design at its declared scope.
status_vocabulary.CANDIDATE: Potentially useful but not admitted for final mixed-corpus training.
status_vocabulary.RETROFIT_REQUIRED: Useful donor semantics exist but current structure violates or predates current integrated training ontology.
status_vocabulary.COMPONENT_ONLY: May train/probe a narrow isolated skill but cannot count as integrated Zero/EntityOS cognition.
status_vocabulary.QUARANTINE: Must not enter training until the named defect is repaired and successor evidence passes.
status_vocabulary.SUPERSEDED: A newer artifact replaces the current-facing role; retain for provenance only.
status_vocabulary.STALE: Authority/source identity is old enough that current claims require refresh.
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: Required evidence or deterministic labeler is absent.
status_vocabulary.RECHECK_REQUIRED: Insufficient exact-current audit evidence in this cycle; fail closed for promotion.

sources: arXiv:2407.12404 Analyzing the Generalization and Reliability of Steering Vectors
arXiv:2505.22637 Understanding (Un)Reliability of Steering Vectors in Language Models
external_research_deltas.source_claim: Steering effectiveness varies substantially across inputs and can be brittle to prompt/distribution changes; coherent activation-difference geometry predicts better reliability.
external_research_deltas.training_delta: Do not promote a single control vector or one prompt family as semantic J-Space truth. Require cross-family/prompt generalization, sign-consistency, geometry/coherence diagnostics and behavior-level causal controls.

sources: arXiv:2503.16851 Towards LLM Guardrails via Sparse Representation Steering
external_research_deltas.source_claim: Dense high-dimensional steering can be polysemantic; sparse feature-space decomposition can improve precision and interpretability in the studied models.
external_research_deltas.training_delta: Prefer factorized evaluation of semantic state, episode-local binding/route and symbol writeout; keep sparse/subspace factorization as a research hypothesis rather than forcing one dense semantic axis.

sources: arXiv:2403.00745 AtP*: An efficient and scalable method for localizing LLM behaviour to components
external_research_deltas.source_claim: Interventions/activation patching are used to identify causally important model components; approximate attribution methods can have false negatives and require verification.
external_research_deltas.training_delta: J-Space positive-label promotion requires executable causal intervention evidence with verification controls; decodability, cvec transport or correlation alone remains insufficient.

sources: arXiv:2206.13034 Monitoring Shortcut Learning using Mutual Information
external_research_deltas.source_claim: Mutual-information analysis can expose shortcut/spurious-correlation learning that ordinary in-distribution performance may hide.
external_research_deltas.training_delta: Retain conditional-MI and nuisance-only decoder gates, but treat them as shortcut diagnostics rather than model-semantic proof.

next_exact_actions: Implement a successor semantic-Hyperposition gate/reference-labeler package that validates deterministic before/after U-update, D-resolve, discriminator adequacy, branch permutation and evidence-ancestry independence.

Compile the current cognitive-process census into one deterministic Hyperposition-native trajectory generator covering variable N, DB-vs-simulation, Claude handoff/return, workspace re-entry, recovery and effect-boundary behavior.
Converge rather than duplicate the open binder visible-surface gates in PR2005/2006/2007, then run them on exact serialized ABI-rendered bytes after the 46-atom/tokenizer binding is verified.
Keep binding-router v3 quarantined; salvage only proof-topology/router-isolation donors onto the v2 full-cross schedule or a preregistered equivalent that passes conditional independence.
Freeze train/validation/holdout by semantic family, generator ancestry, provenance and atom pool before rendering; no holdout-guided tuning.
Before any positive J-Space training labels, preregister a fresh model-specific causal successor with lesion/shuffle/rescue or verified activation-patching-style controls and untouched holdout.
